paper_title: One Tokenizer To Rule Them All Emergent Language Plasticity via   Multilingual Tokenizers
caption: : Effect of vocabulary size.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the effect of vocabulary size on model accuracy, with the x-axis representing vocabulary size in tokens, marked at 100k, 175k, and 250k, and the y-axis representing accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 40.5% to 42.0%. The plot displays two lines: a blue line with star markers representing the "universal" tokenizer, which starts at 40.5% accuracy at 100k tokens and increases steadily to 42.0% at 250k tokens; and an orange line with circle markers representing the "cluster" tokenizer, which begins at 41.6% accuracy at 100k tokens, rises to a peak of 41.8% at 175k tokens, then declines to 41.5% at 250k tokens.
